history.summary: Swayambhu (self-manifested) Hanuman temple at Lambhvel village, ~2 km from Anand city on the Anand-Nadiad highway (Dandi Road); one travel blog calls it 500+ years old (single-source, unverified). The idol is regarded as Swayambhu; the shrine has been renovated in white marble and sits in a large campus with a marriage hall and social-service facilities. Thousands gather on Saturdays and Tuesdays, and a big fair is held on Kali Chaudas (day before Diwali). CSV name 'Hanumanji Temple' is generic, so this is the most likely referent - the famous Anand-area Hanuman shrine (identity flagged as probable, not certain); CSV town 'Anand' corrected to Lambhvel. Opening-hours conflict between sources: 5:00 AM-9:00 PM (nrievents) vs 7:00 AM-7:00 PM (templetravel) - verify.

name: Swayambhu Hanumanji Temple (Lambhvel)
town_description: Lambhvel is a village in Anand district, Gujarat, about 2 km from Anand city on the Anand-Nadiad highway (Dandi Road). It is known mainly for its Swayambhu Hanumanji temple, a centre of faith in and around Anand.

travel.road: Anand ST bus stand (~3 km); on the Anand-Nadiad highway (Dandi Road)
